results/cost_accuracy.json holds PCG at 10/20/30/50 iterations. No single tolerance gives 20-50: matching the direct FV solve's |peak| and det.MAE to 1e-4 K gives 30-50 (g4 50, g5 30, g6 30); to 5e-4 or 1e-3 K gives 20-30. The README's 20-50 is the first count whose hotspot location equals the direct solve's and whose |peak| error is within 2e-4 K of it (g4 50, g5 20, g6 20), i.e. a reading of the report 9.32 table at its printed precision; the range depends on that threshold
